To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the reactivities of metal compounds in polymer degradation are determined by the structure of the metal-containing complex and by the structure of polar additives present in polymer.
the reactions of metal-containing compounds in non-polymer media can be well understood and that these reactions can be weil correlated with those in polymer media.
the reactions in non-polar solvents are quite different from those in polar media.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following problems: 1. the mechanism of the degradation of polymethyl methacrylate and polypropylene initiated by metal compounds, 2. the mechanism of reactions of metal compounds with low molecular model compounds in non-pole media, 3. the role of polar compounds in the degradation processes of polymers.
the study of reactions of metal compounds with polymers in various media.
the reactions of metal-containing compounds in non-polymer systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
metal compounds can play a role in the polymer degradation both as the oxidation or reduction agent.
the metal compounds are capable of initiating the degradation of polymcrs both in the presence of oxygen and in its absence.

the metal compounds are able to initiate polymer degradation in non-polar environments, and that the course of reaction is influenced by the structure of the metal complexes and by the presence of polar compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reactions of metal complexes in non-polar solvents are very complex and the role of polar compounds in the initiation and propagation of degradation reactions cannot be neglected.
, in non-polar solvents, the reactivity of metal compounds in oxidation and reduction initiation is similar to the corresponding reactions in aqueous media.
the reactions of metal complexes in non-polar solvents are quite similar to the reactions in aqueous media.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reactivity and the selectivity of the metal compounds are strongly influenced by the presence of polar compounds.
the reaction of radicals with metal complexes is a very important process, and the results can be weil correlated.
the reactivity and the mechanism of reactions of metal complexes in polar and non-polar media are very similar.
